To help us accomplish this, we are seeking a qualified Data Science Engineer to support decision\-making in plant breeding and horticultural research initiatives. In this role, you will work closely with R\&D biologists and agronomists to design best practices for collecting data and understanding their data needs; translating those needs in close collaboration with IT to build robust data products; and supporting other data scientists in statistical modeling, machine learning, and visualization endeavors. This position will be located in Sevilla, Spain .
  
  

This role will work with diverse colleagues from around the world. While much of the work will be global or international, the role will also have a regional focus—supporting the data science needs of R\&D teams in Europe and Africa
  
  

**JOB SETTING:**  

This position is based at the Fall Creek research farm in Sevilla, Spain, and will be expected to be physically present at the research farm every workday. The position will also require occasional domestic and international travel.
  
  

**What you'll do at Fall Creek:**  

Design, engineer, and maintain complex, multi\-modal databases for plant phenotypic and environmental data from multiple sources.
  
Develop, test, and implement data quality models within data processing pipelines.
  
Implement data governance standards, including metadata and data provenance tracking.
  
Support company\-wide initiatives for AI data readiness.
  
Act as a liaison between R\&D and IT teams, such as translating data collection needs from biologists into guidance for data pipelines.
  
Acting as a technical domain expert collaborating with regional colleagues on data science projects, such as designing horticultural management experiments, statistical analysis of breeding trials, and processing of climate time\-series data for integrating into forecasting, genomic selection, or other models.
  
Communicate project results to technical and non\-technical stakeholders across regions, supporting the improvement of variety development.
  
Collaboratively and critically evaluate and incorporate new data collection technologies aimed at improving breeding methodologies.
  
Adhere to company values and treat colleagues with respect.
  
  

**What you bring to Fall Creek:**  

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

**One of the following:** a Ph.D. degree in a relevant field, a Master’s degree in a relevant field with 3 years of experience,
  
OR a Bachelor’s degree with 5 years of relevant experience.
  
  

Strong background in data modeling, ETL processes, and database design.
  
  

Hands\-on experience with data pipeline tools, experience building and maintaining in\-house data products, proficiency in SQL, Python, and/or R, and familiarity with version control (Git).
  
  

A commitment to ethical action and adherence to humanistic values of humility, skepticism, and curiosity.
  
  

Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a cross\-disciplinary and diverse, international team.
  
  

Demonstrated ability to independently identify opportunities and to support and prioritize requests from stakeholders for data processing, engineering, analysis, and visualization needs.
  
  

Excellent organizational skills, able to manage multiple projects from diverse stakeholders.
  
  

Excellent oral and written communication skills, with emphasis on ability to translate technical data science concepts for diverse, non\-technical audiences.
  
  

Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish.
  
  

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

Familiarity with biology or related fields such as agricultural science, horticulture, plant breeding, ecology, or environmental science.
  
  

Experience with interactive data visualization programs such as PowerBI or Shiny.
  
  

Experience evaluating high\-throughput plant phenotyping or precision agriculture technologies.
  
  

Familiarity with AI data readiness principles.
  
  

Familiarity with Microsoft SharePoint platform
  
  

Who is Fall Creek?
  
  

We’re a US\-based company with a keen focus on blueberry genetics, plants, and grower support delivered to the world’s premier blueberry growers. From our humble beginnings in Lowell, Oregon more than 40 years ago, we now also have wholly\-owned nurseries in Mexico, Peru, Spain, South Africa, Netherlands, China, and Chile. Additionally, we have built a global team of the finest breeders, researchers, propagators and nursery professionals, grower support technicians, sales and customer service experts and more. We’re a deeply\-planted link in a global chain, ready to serve our customers and our industry throughout North, Central, and South America, Greater Europe, Asia, and Africa. Our mission is to serve the growers and to support the blueberry industry, helping to ensure growers maximize success through our delivery of the best genetics and plants, technical know\-how and global market intelligence. To fulfill our mission, we focus on cultivating exceptional plants, building strong relationships and providing responsive customer service. This is all part of how we’re helping to build A World with Better Blueberries™.

We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
   

  

 Lilly is looking for a Data Scientist to join the technology team in Indianapolis, IN supporting Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA), Global Scientific Communications (GSC), and Global Statistical Sciences (GSS). You will apply data science, machine learning, and AI techniques to solve real business problems — from building agents to automate manual regulatory workflows and optimizing clinical trial processes to building predictive models that drive smarter decisions across the portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of data, domain expertise, and engineering. You won’t just build models in notebooks — you’ll partner with business stakeholders to understand the problem and with leadership to quantify the impact of your work.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 As a Data Scientist, you will work across the portfolio to identify opportunities where data science and AI can create measurable business value. You’ll analyze complex datasets — regulatory documents, clinical trial data, submission timelines, operational metrics — to uncover patterns, build predictive models, and develop AI\-powered solutions. You’ll design and evaluate machine learning models, build NLP and generative AI applications for regulatory and scientific content, and collaborate closely with full stack engineers to move your work from prototype to production. You operate in a regulated, GxP environment where data integrity, reproducibility, and validation are not optional.
   

  

**How You’ll Succeed**
* Partnering with business stakeholders across GRA, GSC, and GSS to understand their workflows, identify high\-impact problems, and frame them as data science opportunities — translating business questions into analytical approaches.
* Developing and deploying machine learning models — classification, regression, clustering, time\-series forecasting — to solve problems such as submission timeline prediction, document classification, regulatory risk scoring, and resource optimization.
* Building and evaluating NLP and generative AI solutions — leveraging LLMs, RAG architectures, text extraction, entity recognition, and document summarization to automate regulatory authoring, scientific literature analysis, and content generation workflows.

* Communicating findings and recommendations to both technical and non\-technical audiences — using data visualization, storytelling, and clear business\-impact framing to ensure your work drives actual decisions.
* Staying current with emerging techniques in machine learning, generative AI, and data science — evaluating new tools, frameworks, and approaches for applicability to the GRA/GSC/GSS portfolio and sharing knowledge with the broader team.

Wir sind einer der größten Arbeitgeber in Münster – auch in der IT\-Branche.  

  

Gestalte gemeinsam mit über 700 IT\-Kolleg:innen die digitale Zukunft unserer Versicherung. Die IT@LVM sorgt mit innovativen und zukunftsweisenden Lösungen für die optimale Unterstützung unserer Geschäftsprozesse – für rund 12\.000 Nutzer:innen im Innen\- und Außendienst sowie über 3,9 Mio. Kund:innen deutschlandweit \- Tendenz steigend.  

  

Von der Anwendungsentwicklung über den technischen Service bis zur kompletten Infrastruktur setzen wir konsequent auf viele eigenentwickelte Lösungen und moderne Technologien am Markt. Auch als Berufseinsteiger:in hast du bei uns die Chance, unsere IT\-Themen aktiv mitzugestalten und deine Ideen einzubringen.  

  

Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere IT\-Vision leben. Deshalb suchen wir dich als  

  

**Data Scientist (m/w/d)**

  

### **Deine Aufgaben**


* Zu deinen zentralen Aufgaben gehört die Umsetzung diverser technischer Weiterentwicklungen von Anwendungen im Bereich der Künstlichen Intelligenz mit Python\-Backend und Angular\-Frontend.
* Du übernimmst selbstständig die fachliche Koordination und Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen.
* Prompt Engineering für KI‑Anwendungen sowie die Unterstützung anderer Teams durch Beratung und Best Practices gehören zu deinen zentralen Aufgaben.
* Beim Einsatz von KI‑Lösungen berücksichtigst du wirtschaftliche und regulatorische Rahmenbedingungen.
* In enger Abstimmung mit unserer Product Ownerin unterstützt du bei der Konzeptionierung von Features.
* Dabei arbeitest du interdisziplinär mit den Fachabteilungen, der IT sowie externen Anbietern von KI‑Lösungen zusammen.


### **Deine Voraussetzungen**


* Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts\-)Informatik, der Mathematik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
* Du verfügst über Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Python.
* Erste Erfahrungen im Thema Künstlicher Intelligenz hast du bereits gesammelt und du bringst die Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen fachlichen Weiterentwicklung im KI‑Umfeld mit.
* Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu erkennen, zu analysieren, zu bewerten und wirtschaftliche Lösungen zu entwickeln.
* Dein gutes Organisationsgeschick und deine eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise zeichnen dich aus.
* Du hast Freude daran, mit Kolleg:innen interdisziplinär zusammenzuarbeiten und komplexe Themen verständlich zu vermitteln.
* Deine Kommunikation ist sicher und zielgruppenorientiert, ob im Team, mit Fachbereichen oder externen Dienstleistern.
* Initiative, Engagement und die Bereitschaft, sich neuen fachlichen und technischen Herausforderungen zu stellen, runden dein Profil ab.


### **Deine Vorteile**

  

  

**Gehalt**: Du erhältst bei uns eine tariflich geregelte Vergütung (gem. Tarifvertrag für die private Versicherungswirtschaft). Zusätzlich erhältst du Urlaubs\- und Weihnachtsgeld sowie umfangreiche Sozialleistungen \- darunter eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Darüber hinaus erwartet dich ein zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz.  

  

**Homeoffice**: Je nach Stelle und Absprache mit deiner Führungskraft kannst du zwischen verschiedenen Homeoffice\-Modellen wählen. Dabei sind mindestens zwei Tage am LVM\-Campus vorgesehen. Neben einer vollwertigen technischen Ausstattung erhältst du eine einmalige Homeoffice\-Pauschale von 800 € brutto.

Dabei wird jede geleistete Überstunde selbstverständlich ausbezahlt oder kann alternativ durch Freizeit ausgeglichen werden.  

  

**Flexibilität:** Ergänzend zu unserer Homeoffice\-Regelung kannst du bis zu zehn weiteren Tagen mobil innerhalb Deutschlands oder im EU\-Ausland arbeiten. Damit fördern wir die Vereinbarkeit deiner beruflichen und privaten Ziele.

Bei der LVM legen wir großen Wert auf persönlichen Kontakt und den Aufbau von langfristigen Beziehungen. Daher laden wir dich herzlich in unseren Talentepool ein. Dort bieten wir dir:

**Rückmeldung:** Da am Auswahlverfahren mehrere Parteien beteiligt sind und wir Wert auf eine sorgfältige Prüfung legen, kann es etwas dauern, bis du eine erste Rückmeldung erhältst.

In der Regel nimmt eine Person aus der Fachabteilung und eine Person aus der Personalabteilung am Erstgespräch teil.


**Zweites Gespräch:** Nach dem Erstgespräch beraten sich die Beteiligten und treffen zeitnah eine Entscheidung. War das Erstgespräch erfolgreich, folgt die Einladung zu einem Zweitgespräch. Es bietet die Möglichkeit, den fachlichen Austausch zu vertiefen, weitere Fragen zu klären und ggf. das Team kennenzulernen. Des Weiteren hast du die Möglichkeit zur Besichtigung deines zukünftigen Arbeitsplatzes. Für das Zweitgespräch solltest du ca. zwei Stunden einplanen.


**Vertragsunterzeichnung:** Sollte das zweite Gespräch erfolgreich verlaufen und dein Interesse an einer Mitarbeit in unserem Unternehmen weiterhin bestehen, werden wir deine Bewerbung dem Betriebsausschuss vorstellen und ein Vertragsangebot für dich erstellen. Wir benötigen von dir einen Lebenslauf sowie deine letzten Arbeitszeugnisse (sofern vorhanden) und dein letztes Schul\- oder Studienzeugnis (z. B. Berufsausbildungs‑/Studienabschlusszeugnis oder Abiturzeugnis). Optional kannst du deiner Bewerbung ein Anschreiben beifügen.

description:
**NEW CAREER OPPORTUNITY**

  

Build your career with Kraken Robotics. Make a difference to others. If innovation drives you, and you want a career that makes a difference to the world, helping humanity overcome the challenges in our oceans – safely, efficiently, and sustainably – **then come join us at Kraken Robotics.**

 **Kraken Robotics** is currently seeking a **Senior Data Scientist** to join our team. This position can be Remote or working out of any of our Global Offices.

  

Kraken’s Sensor Research Group (SRG) is dedicated to accelerating innovation in sensor technology through agile prototyping and hands\-on experimentation. By rapidly exploring new concepts and technical pathways, the team aims to uncover opportunities and address potential limitations early in development—well before significant resources are committed to scaling or commercialization.

  

The SRG also addresses urgent technology challenges, defects, and operational issues by leveraging in\-house Subject Matter Experts to develop fast, field\-testable solutions. This quick feedback loop helps refine or redirect development efforts efficiently.

  

We are currently seeking a Senior Data Scientist with expertise in marine data processing. Experience with AI/ML techniques applied to sensor data is a strong asset.

  

Kraken fosters a culture of collaboration, experimentation, and calculated risk\-taking. Within the SRG, this translates to rapid prototyping, frequent iteration, and close engagement with operators to ensure solutions are grounded in real\-world performance. The group values agility over perfection \- quickly developing and testing ideas to learn what works, what doesn't, and where to go next.

 **Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Develop, maintain, and execute strategic research initiatives within the Sensor Research Group.
* Conduct hands\-on R\&D and prototyping across Kraken’s portfolio of underwater sensor systems, sonar processing, and machine learning\-based analytics.
* Identify innovation opportunities and assess emerging technologies in sensor processing and data analytics.
* Enhance and expand Kraken’s data processing pipelines, workflows, and infrastructure.
* Improve access to existing datasets and apply them to model training, validation, and broader team use in research and development efforts.
* Contribute to the scientific community through collaborative research, conference participation, academic publications, and partnerships with universities.
* Support business development through technical discussions with customers and contributions to proposal writing.
* Participate in knowledge\-sharing events, technical workshops, and cross\-functional innovation discussions.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Education: Master’s / PhD degree in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, with a focus on data processing, machine learning, or sensor analytics.
* Experience:
* + 8\+ years experience in research and development or industry
	+ Experience with marine data processing
* Technical Expertise:
* + Experience in cloud infrastructure and scaling
	+ Knowledge of marine geospatial data and related formats
	+ Background in machine learning and large data processing
	+ Proficiency in Python and C\+\+
	+ Familiarity with GPU\-accelerated computing and distributed data architectures
	+ Knowledge of sensor fusion, sonar processing, sensor processing and data analysis, or other relevant technologies.
	+ Familiarity with underwater environment dynamics and applications of underwater sensor systems.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities with a focus on innovation and practical application.
* Proven ability to self\-organize research efforts, including defining and pursuing ambitious technical objectives.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, multidisciplinary, and highly collaborative environment.
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies and rapid prototyping approaches.
* Excellent communication skills for presenting technical findings and collaborating with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Effective at managing time and resources in support of evolving research priorities.

title: AI Automation Engineer (d/m/w) – Automation Enablement
description:
Freiburg


ab sofort
Gemäß unserer **Lexware** Mission **„Wir erleichtern Unternehmertum"** ist die stetige Automatisierung der Geschäftsprozesse ein Kernversprechen an unsere Kund:innen. Bereits heute setzen wir an mehreren Stellen im Produkt KI\-Modelle produktiv ein und wissen: Ein hoher Automatisierungsgrad trägt wesentlich zur Kundenzufriedenheit bei. Gleichzeitig schlummert im Produkt noch enormes Potenzial, das wir gemeinsam heben wollen.



Dafür bauen wir eine neue Domäne auf: Automation Enablement. Unser Ziel ist es, den Feature\-Teams ein niederschwelliges Angebot zu schaffen, mit dem sie datenbasiert Automatisierungspotenziale schnell und risikoarm erproben können – von ersten Experimenten bis hin zur produktiven Skalierung.



Als **AI Automation Engineer (d/m/w)** bist du mittendrin: Du bringst fundiertes Wissen über aktuelle KI\- und ML\-Ansätze mit, arbeitest hands\-on an Prototypen und Benchmarks und begleitest die Teams auf dem Weg von der Idee über das Experiment bis in die Produktion. Du gestaltest Blueprints, facilitierst in wechselnden Teams und treibst gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen die Weiterentwicklung der Domäne voran.



Selbstverständlich kannst du **flexibel** von **zu Hause** arbeiten. Da wir die persönlichen Begegnungen vor Ort ebenfalls sehr schätzen, treffen wir uns **wöchentlich** in unserem Büro in **Freiburg im Breisgau**.


### **DAS ERWARTET DICH:**


* **Enablement \& Facilitation:** Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Feature\-Teams zusammen, identifizierst Automatisierungspotenziale und unterstützt sie dabei, diese systematisch zu erkunden und umzusetzen. Du bist Sparringspartner:in für alle Fragen rund um KI und ML.
* **Experimente \& Benchmarks:** Du konzipierst und führst hands\-on Experimente durch, um die Machbarkeit von Automatisierungsansätzen zu bewerten – von der Auswahl geeigneter Modelle über die Aufbereitung passender Datengrundlagen bis hin zur transparenten Kommunikation der Ergebnisse und iterative Optimierung
* **Blueprints \& Best Practices:** Du entwickelst wiederverwendbare Blueprints und stellst sicher, dass State\-of\-the\-Art\-Wissen im Team und in der Organisation verfügbar ist.
* **Begleitung in die Produktion:** Du begleitest den Weg von erfolgreichen Experimenten in den produktiven Einsatz – inklusive Themen wie Compliance, Safety, Skalierung und Monitoring.
* **Domänenentwicklung:** Du gestaltest die neue Domäne Automation Enablement aktiv mit – von der eigenen Arbeitsweise bis hin zur strategischen Ausrichtung.


### **DAS BRINGST DU MIT:**


* **Datenhandwerk:** Solide Kenntnisse in Python und SQL sind für dich selbstverständlich. Du bringst Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse, Datenaufbereitung und im Umgang mit synthetischen Daten bzw. Labeling\-Strategien mit.
* **KI\- \& ML\-Expertise:** Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Machine Learning und Large Language Models sowie mit gängigen Frameworks und Bibliotheken (z. B. PyTorch, Scikit\-learn, Hugging Face). Du bist vertraut mit aktuellen Ansätzen wie Fine\-Tuning, Prompt Engineering, agentische Systeme, sowie KI\-bezogenen Protokollen (z. B. MCP, A2A) und hältst dich eigenständig über neue Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden.
* **MLOps \& Deployment:** Du weißt, wie man KI\-Modelle nicht nur trainiert, sondern auch zuverlässig in Produktion bringt und betreibt – idealerweise in Cloud. Erfahrung mit CI/CD für ML\-Workflows, Modell\-Monitoring und Skalierung ist ein großes Plus.
* **Teamfähigkeit \& Kommunikation:** Du bist in der Lage, dich schnell in wechselnde Teamkontexte einzufinden und dort als Facilitator:in und Wissensträger:in zu wirken. Transparente Kommunikation und Resilienz zeichnen dich aus.
* **Sprachen:** Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1\) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

**Wir setzen auf Team\-Recruiting** \- Die Bewerbungsgespräche führt unser Team selbst. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennen zu lernen.


* **Andreas** ist begeistert davon, das Automatisierungserlebnis unserer Kund:innen durch datengestützte Ansätze auf ein neues Level zu heben. Außerhalb der Arbeitszeit verbringt er seine Zeit gerne auf dem Tennisplatz oder erkundet neue kulinarische Kreationen, um das Leben aufzupeppen.
* **Jiri** hat ein Faible für Data Ops und kundenzentrierte Lösungen für Big Data Herausforderungen. An den Wochenenden verbringt er seine Zeit mit dem Sammeln von Pilzen und verfolgt die neuesten Trends im Bereich NLP.
* **Friederike** schafft als Scrum Masterin die Rahmenbedingungen, in denen wir als Team wirksam zusammen Arbeiten und Verantwortung übernehmen können. In ihrer Freizeit ist sie gerne unterwegs und verbringt viel Zeit mit Freund:innen und Familie.
* **Ralf** liebt es, als Data Scientist aus Daten Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen. Seinem Team hilft er dabei, das Zusammenspiel zwischen Kunden und KI besser zu verstehen, um so noch bessere Produkte zu bauen. Seine Freizeit verbringt er am liebsten mit seiner Familie, beim Klettern oder beim Musizieren (Gitarre und Bass).
* **Camilla** ist als Data Scientistin potenzielle Sparringspartnerin, um mit deiner Unterstützung in ihrem Team Automation Themen voranzutreiben. In ihrer Freizeit ist sie am liebsten mit ihrer Familie und ihrem Hund in der Natur unterwegs oder probiert sich durch Freiburgs Restaurants.

At JD.com, also known as JINGDONG, we are building one of the world’s most trusted technology and supply chain ecosystems. What started as a bold idea in China has evolved into a NASDAQ\-listed, Fortune 44 global enterprise serving over 700 million active customers. Powered by advanced logistics, innovative technology, and a commitment to integrity, JD.com operates across retail, logistics, technology, property and more, creating solutions that make everyday life smarter, faster, and more connected.

**Our Global Reach**


JD.com is expanding its international footprint through a digitally intelligent, cross\-border supply chain and world\-class logistics network, supported by platforms such as Joybuy, which brings trusted products to customers worldwide. Today, our teams operate across China, the U.S., U.K., Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Hungary, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and beyond, reaching customers in every corner of the world.


Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://corporate.jd.com/


**What We Offer**


Joining JD.com means becoming part of a company where people, innovation, and impact go hand in hand. We offer a competitive salary, a great location, and a supportive, people\-first culture where your growth truly matters. With access to global projects, learning opportunities, and an inclusive environment that values every voice, you’ll have the space to shape the future with us.

**About The Team**


You’ll be joining the JD.com team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high\-quality results in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.


JD.com is seeking a Data Scientist to develop data\-driven insights and machine learning models that power our personalization, recommendation, and analytics systems. In this role, you will transform raw data into business intelligence, working closely with data engineers, product managers, and business teams to improve decision\-making and enhance customer experience across JD.com’s international e\-commerce operations. Learn more: https://corporate.jd.com/

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Build predictive models and advanced analytics solutions to improve personalization, recommendation, and customer segmentation.
* Analyze large\-scale datasets to identify behavioral trends, business opportunities, and product improvement areas.
* Partner with data engineers to ensure clean, reliable, and accessible data for experimentation and model deployment.
* Design and run A/B tests to measure the impact of algorithms and product features.
* Translate technical insights into clear, actionable recommendations for business and product stakeholders.
* Stay current with research and industry best practices in machine learning, NLP, and AI, applying them to real\-world e\-commerce challenges.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Master’s degree or higher in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied analytics.
* Proficiency in Python, R, or Scala, with strong skills in data analysis and statistical modeling.
* Experience with ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn) and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
* Strong knowledge of A/B testing, experimentation design, and causal inference.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings to non\-technical stakeholders.

-----------------------------

* Experience in global e\-commerce, personalization, or recommendation systems.
* Familiarity with big data platforms (Spark, Hadoop) and cloud ML pipelines (AWS Sagemaker, GCP Vertex AI, or Azure ML).

Wir sind einer der größten Arbeitgeber in Münster – auch in der IT\-Branche.  

  

Gestalte gemeinsam mit über 700 IT\-Kolleg:innen die digitale Zukunft unserer Versicherung. Die IT@LVM sorgt mit innovativen und zukunftsweisenden Lösungen für die optimale Unterstützung unserer Geschäftsprozesse – für rund 12\.000 Nutzer:innen im Innen\- und Außendienst sowie über 3,9 Mio. Kund:innen deutschlandweit \- Tendenz steigend.  

  

Von der Anwendungsentwicklung über den technischen Service bis zur kompletten Infrastruktur setzen wir konsequent auf viele eigenentwickelte Lösungen und moderne Technologien am Markt. Auch als Berufseinsteiger:in hast du bei uns die Chance, unsere IT\-Themen aktiv mitzugestalten und deine Ideen einzubringen.  

  

Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere IT\-Vision leben. Deshalb suchen wir dich als  

  

**Data Scientist (m/w/d) \- Aktuariat Haftpflicht**

  

### **Deine Aufgaben**


* Du analysierst und validierst umfassende Datenbestände, um Trends und Muster zu identifizieren, die für strategische Entscheidungen und Produktentwicklungen von Bedeutung sind.
* Darüber hinaus führst du komplexe Datenanalysen durch und implementierst innovative Methoden der Data Science und des maschinellen Lernens zur Unterstützung aktuarieller Prozesse.
* Du arbeitest eng mit den Schnittstellen aus IT und Fachbereichen zusammen, um passgenaue Lösungen zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Modelle, Produkte und Prozesse zu entwickeln.
* Die Entwicklung und Optimierung prädiktiver Modelle zur Risikobewertung und Tarifgestaltung im Bereich Haftpflicht fallen in dein Tätigkeitsfeld.
* Zu deinen Aufgaben gehört die Erstellung von Berichten und Dashboards zur Visualisierung von Ergebnissen und zur Entscheidungsfindung.
* Du unterstützt das Management bei strategischen Fragestellungen und gestaltest aktiv abteilungsinterne und \-übergreifende Projekte mit.


### **Deine Voraussetzungen**


* Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Diplom oder Master) der (Wirtschafts\-)Mathematik, Statistik, Informatik oder eines vergleichbaren Fachbereichs.
* Darüber hinaus hast du fundierte Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von Programmiersprachen wie SQL und Python und bist erfahren im Umgang mit modernen Analysewerkzeugen (z.B. PowerBI).
* Deine analytischen Fähigkeiten sowie dein konzeptionelles Denken zeichnen dich aus.
* Komplexe Zusammenhänge zu erkennen und verständlich darzustellen gehört zu deinen Stärken.
* Du bist bereit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und bringst eine hohe Eigeninitiative und Kommunikationsfähigkeit mit.
* Außerdem bringst du die Bereitschaft mit, mindestens drei Tage pro Woche vor Ort am Campus zu arbeiten.
* Eine ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit, Zielorientierung und die Bereitschaft, innovative und kreative Lösungen zu entwickeln, runden dein Profil ab.


### **Deine Vorteile**

  

  

**Gehalt**: Du erhältst bei uns eine tariflich geregelte Vergütung (gem. Tarifvertrag für die private Versicherungswirtschaft). Zusätzlich erhältst du Urlaubs\- und Weihnachtsgeld sowie umfangreiche Sozialleistungen \- darunter eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Darüber hinaus erwartet dich ein zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz.  

  

**Homeoffice**: Je nach Stelle und Absprache mit deiner Führungskraft kannst du zwischen verschiedenen Homeoffice\-Modellen wählen. Dabei sind mindestens zwei Tage am LVM\-Campus vorgesehen. Neben einer vollwertigen technischen Ausstattung erhältst du eine einmalige Homeoffice\-Pauschale von 800 € brutto.

* Design and operate Data Quality dimensions, thresholds/SLOs, rules and scoring for priority assets and metrics.

**Role Overview**


A newly established Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DS\&AI) for Operations function aims to generate insight, improve operational processes and help the agency meet future demand while improving the quality of our valuations.


You will play a leadership role in driving forwards our aim to position the VO as a practical test bed for operational data science and AI. You will engage with our stakeholders across the department to identify the highest impact areas to work in and lead innovative projects, both internally and collaboratively through our partners and the wider tech sector. We can provide you with a unique opportunity to shape, change and drive Data Science and AI across VO and provide an excellent experience thatll enhance your future career prospects and skills development **\-** **Tetyana Mykhaylyk, Director of Information, Data \& Analysis**

Established in 2025, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DS\&AI) for Operations was created to drive a step‑change in how VOA Operations use data, analytics and AI to deliver better outcomes. The function works hand‑in‑hand with operational teams to meet the analytical needs of modern government, from advanced analytics to the responsible adoption of generative AI tools that support day‑to‑day decision‑making and delivery.

Working in close partnership with the other Lead Data Scientist (Data Science and AI), you will play a pivotal role in advancing the DS\&AI function and shaping the strategic vision for the organisations use of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence to enhance operational performance. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

* Leadership \& Vision: Take ownership of the development and direction of DS\&AI, setting bold, forward\-thinking strategies that will leverage Data Science and AI to deliver improved public services and drive organisational efficiency.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Secure strong engagement, commitment and support from senior leaders and managers, fostering a shared commitment to the DS\&AI vision and strategy across all levels of the organisation.

description:
**ABOUT ORGANOX:**


OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543\) strives to fulfil its mission of “Contributing to Society through Healthcare” by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

 **Position Summary**

The Data Scientist will be part of the Data team, within the Digital function in OrganOx. OrganOx’s Data team is changing the way OrganOx operates around data, increasing efficiencies and enabling teams to deliver data\-based solutions to make every organ count. The Data Scientist will deliver a collection of Data assets for OrganOx, according to strategic priorities and organisational needs. The assets will include (but not be limited to):


* End\-to\-end Predictive Machine Learning Models on different domains.
* Advanced analysis for key projects, supporting critical projects in the organisation.
* Develop root cause analysis for specific organisational domains.
* Technological solutions in the data realm to support a variety of stakeholders.


Being part of a small team, the Data Scientist will show a flexible approach to problem solving and the capacity to be hands on in all the steps of the data development cycle (such as, requirement capture, problem framing, data cleansing, ML pilot development, model serving, data graphics, final reporting). It is expected that the Data Scientist will follow the Data Team ways of working, as well as contributing to the development and improvement of the ways of working and wider data culture at OrganOx.


This is an on\-site position in Oxford UK, with flexibility, the ensure stakeholder engagement with Engineering, Quality and other relevant business units.


Listed below are the major responsibilities of the role and a brief description of some of the key tasks to be performed. This list is not totally exhaustive.

**Major Responsibilities**

Under direction from the Data Science Functional Lead, the Data Scientist will be responsible for:

* Own the development of ML models producing business\-related predictions.
* Responsible for the delivery of a diverse range of Analytics projects (e.g.: Root Cause analysis, Causal analysis, Hypothesis testing, advanced visualisations) to answer specific business questions, contributing to data led decisions across the business.
* Act as the advocate and point of reference for good data practices.
* Responsible for the production of quality documentation where appropriate.
* Ensure that the Data Team ways of working are followed and contribute to their review and improvement.
* Proactively stay up to date with technology developments within Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence
* Adhere to the letter and spirit of OrganOx’s Code of Conduct and all other company policies

  

**Requirements** **Skills \& Experience**

**Essential:**

* Proven related Data Science / Software Development / Analytics work experience.
* Training in Mathematical and Statistical Foundations, including sampling, distributions, and signal processing
* Well\-established experience implementing ML models.
* Proven track record in developing solutions using Python and SQL
* Familiarity with (having been involved in at least a project covering) software development techniques and development lifecycle (modular design, Continuous Integration/ Continuous Development, testing…).
* Critical thinking; 1\) show evidence and reason through scenarios in which standard box solutions could not apply to a problem; 2\) Show evidence of applying domain\-knowledge to a problem to frame correctly and simplify a technical solution.
* Previous experience of dynamic project scenarios, for example, development work starting early (before clear requirements are set), leading to a collection of changes during different implementation phases.

**Desirable:**

* Comfortable presenting results to technical and non\-technical audiences in written and verbal form (online articles, reports, conferences, etc).
* Able to demonstrate development of 1 or more projects in PySpark.
* Demonstrable experience of development of ML that got served to a live platform and run in a continuous manner from a data feed.
* Proven ability relating to Machine Learning models in TensorFlow or Pytorch.
* Previous exposure to a software or Machine Learning project under an Agile environment.
* Able to evidence experience of an ML project having used a model from a public repository (githb, hugging face…) as a starting point.
* Proven ability and experience in analytics / ML projects in Databricks and/or MS Azure.
* Familiarity with Gen AI working frameworks
* Conceptual understanding and application of automatic data ingestion pipeline from different sources for data projects in cloud environments.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or equivalent technical qualification.
* Ability to travel up to 10 %.

  

**Benefits**  

At OrganOx, we value innovation, evidence, integrity, teamwork, respect, and passion. We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including healthcare and retirement plans. We support work\-life balance and provide opportunities for ongoing professional development.


*We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation race, or any other characteristics protected by law.*

**About client :**  

Well\-funded and fast\-growing deep\-tech company founded in 2019\. We are the biggest Quantum Software company in the EU. They are also one of the 100 most promising companies in AI in the world (according to CB Insights, 2023\) with 150\+ employees and growing, fully multicultural and international. **Requirements*** Systems Programming Expertise: 10\+ years of software engineering experience with strong proficiency in **Python.** You must be comfortable building system agents, APIs, and CLI tools.
* **Deep Kubernetes Knowledge:** You understand K8s internals beyond simple deployment. Experience with Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), Operators, and the Kubernetes API server architecture.
* **GPU Ecosystem Experience:** Hands\-on experience managing NVIDIA GPU clusters. Familiarity with NVIDIA drivers, CUDA toolkit, and the container runtime (NVIDIA Container Toolkit).
* **Linux Internals:** Deep understanding of the Linux kernel, cgroups, namespaces, and system performance tuning.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Mastery of declarative infrastructure tools (Terraform, Ansible) but with a focus on provisioning physical hardware rather than just cloud VMs.
* **Problem Solving:** A proven track record of debugging complex distributed systems where the root cause could be code, network, or silicon.

 **Preferred qualifications*** **HPC Background:** Experience working with traditional supercomputing schedulers (Slurm, PBS) or modern batch schedulers (Volcano, Kueue, Ray).
* **Bare Metal Provisioning:** Experience with tools like Cluster API (CAPI), Metal3, Tinkerbell, Canonical MaaS, or OpenStack Ironic.
* **High\-Speed Networking:** Knowledge of RDMA, InfiniBand, GPUDirect, and how to expose these technologies to containerized workloads.
* **AI/ML Familiarity:** Understanding of how distributed training works (e.g., PyTorch Distributed, Megatron\-LM, DeepSpeed) and the infrastructure requirements of Large Language Models (LLMs).
* **Observability:** Experience building monitoring for hardware health (DCGM) and distributed tracing for long\-running jobs.

 **Location: Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is based** **What you will be doing*** **Building the Control Plane:** Designing and developing the software layer (APIs, Controllers, Agents) that automates the lifecycle of bare\-metal AI infrastructure.
* **Orchestrating High\-Scale Compute:** Architecting scheduling solutions for large\-scale distributed training jobs across massive clusters of GPUs (NVIDIA H200/B200/B300\), ensuring efficient bin\-packing and gang scheduling.
* **Optimizing the Fabric:** Tuning the software\-defined networking layer to support low\-latency interconnects (InfiniBand/RDMA/RoCEv2\) essential for multi\-node training.
* **Developing Kubernetes Extensions:** Writing custom Kubernetes Operators and CRDs to abstract complex hardware realities (topology awareness, GPU partitioning) into usable interfaces for our Data Scientists.
* **Hardware\-Level Debugging:** Investigating and resolving deep systems issues, ranging from PCIe bus errors and NCCL communication timeouts to kernel panics on bare\-metal nodes.
* **Defining Standards:** Creating the "Golden Image" for AI workloads, managing drivers, firmware, and OS optimizations to squeeze maximum performance out of the hardware.

* Equal pay guaranteed.
* Variable performance bonus.
* Signing bonus.
* Relocation package (if applicable).
* Private health insurance.
* Eligibility for educational budget according to internal policy.
* Hybrid opportunity.
* Flexible working hours.
* Working in a high paced environment, working on cutting edge technologies.

description:
**Company Overview**


The SPTS division of KLA, designs, manufactures and markets wafer processing solutions for the global semiconductor and related industries. SPTS provides industry leading etch and deposition process technologies on a range of single wafer handling platforms. End\-market applications include micro\-electromechanical systems (MEMS), advanced packaging, LED, high speed RF device IC’s and power semiconductors. SPTS is part of KLA Corporation which develops industry\-leading equipment and services that enable innovation throughout the electronics industry. We provide advanced process control and process\-enabling solutions for manufacturing wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. In close collaboration with leading customers across the globe, our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers design solutions that move the world forward.**Group/Division**


The KLA Services team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts.**Job** **Description/Preferred** **Qualifications**


Do you want to work on some of the most complex and cutting\-edge technologies in a dynamic, global environment with strong career growth opportunities? If so, **KLA** is looking for talented **Product Install Engineer** to join our European installation team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring our advanced systems are installed and operating to the highest standards at customer sites across the region.

**Your Impact**


As a Product Install Engineer, you’ll be at the forefront of deploying KLA’s PVD, Etch and CVD tools. You’ll collaborate with multicultural teams and travel to some of the most advanced semiconductor fabs in the world. Your work ensures that our tools are installed correctly, validated thoroughly, and ready to deliver value to our customers. In addition to technical expertise, you must be confident in communicating directly with customers, understanding their needs, and ensuring their satisfaction throughout the process. You will be required to follow and work according to documented best known method, and you will have to document the work you perform. The position is based in the UK with travel primarily within Europe.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Customer Engagement \& Planning**
	+ Conduct pre\-installation meetings to understand and document customer\-specific requirements.
	+ Develop action plans to meet unique customer needs and validate deliverables.

* **Tool Installation \& Integration**
	+ Perform full system installations to meet KLA specifications, including:
		- Physical install and connection
		- Precision alignment and calibration
		- Wafer handler robot setup and teaching
		- System\-level calibrations and performance testing
		- Applications verification and product wafer validation

* **Problem Solving \& Issue Resolution**
	+ Troubleshoot complex system issues using data analysis, abstract thinking, and structured problem\-solving methodologies.
	+ Manage critical issues across multiple customer sites and regions.

* **Customer Validation \& Satisfaction**
	+ Lead post\-installation meetings to verify tool performance and ensure customer satisfaction.
	+ Conduct application testing to confirm operational quality.
	+ Maintain strong communication through regular updates and escalation meetings.

* **Training \& Knowledge Sharing**
	+ Deliver training on new product installations to global customer support teams.

**Your Qualifications**

* **Education \& Experience**
	+ Engineering qualification e.g. NVQ, HNC or Degree etc.
	+ Proven experience in a hands\-on Engineering role with Electrical and Mechanical experience

* **Technical Skills**
	+ Familiarity with pneumatics, mechanics, electronics, radio frequency technology, metrology, and laser technologies is desirable.
	+ Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across software, electronic, optical, and mechanical systems.
	+ Proficiency in computer systems and operating environments (e.g., MS Windows).

* **Soft Skills**
	+ Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
	+ Ability to work under pressure and meet project deadlines.
	+ Adaptable \& flexible
	+ Willingness and availability to travel within the UK and Europe (approx. 70%). Occasional international travel maybe required.

**What we will offer you?**


Annual leave starting at 25 days (plus bank holidays), share scheme, contributory pension scheme, cash health plan, cycle to work scheme, global bonus plan, rewards scheme, life assurance and generous shift allowance.

**Minimum Qualifications**

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*

KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Description
  
Role Purpose
  
  

Ensure the linguistic and phonetic quality of Omilia’s multilingual Text\-to\-Speech (TTS) systems by designing phoneme inventories, developing lexicons, and reviewing audio corpora to support enterprise\-grade voice experiences.
  
  

Accountabilities
  
**Autonomy:** Independently conduct phonological and phonetic analysis, design phoneme inventories, and develop lexicons for multiple languages.
  
**Scope \& Complexity:** Responsible for linguistic quality across all supported languages in TTS, including handling underrepresented phenomena and complex language\-specific features.
  
**Impact:** Directly influences the naturalness, accuracy, and quality of Omilia’s TTS output, impacting customer experience in global contact center deployments.
  
**Influence/Mentorship:** Collaborates with TTS engineers, data scientists, and ML researchers; coordinates with native\-speaker reviewers and external annotation pipelines.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Conduct systematic phonological and phonetic analysis of the Canadian French and Canadian English languages.
  
Document language\-specific features (prosody, stress, tone, coarticulation, dialect variation).
  
Produce structured language profiles for TTS model training and evaluation.
  
Define and maintain phoneme inventories; map to IPA and TTS\-specific conventions.
  
Corpus audits and optimal audio references selections for TTS target voice tuning
  
Build and maintain pronunciation lexicons, including G2P rules and exceptions.
  
Review and correct machine\-generated G2P outputs; conduct pronunciation audits.
  
Annotate audio corpora, develop evaluation protocols, and produce error analyses.
  
Define linguistic criteria for TTS corpus selection and design prompts for data collection.
  
Collaborate with TTS engineers to integrate linguistic artefacts into synthesis pipelines.
  
Contribute to internal documentation and participate in research discussions.
  
Requirements
  
M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Linguistics, Phonetics, Computational Linguistics, or related field.
  
Proven experience building pronunciation lexicons or G2P systems for TTS or ASR.
  
Deep knowledge of phonological theory, articulatory and acoustic phonetics.
  
Proficiency with IPA and at least one machine\-readable phoneme notation system (X\-SAMPA, ARPAbet, etc.).
  
Experience with corpus annotation tools (Praat, ELAN, WebAnno, etc.).
  
Strong analytical and documentation skills.
  
Fluency in English; proficiency in at least one additional language relevant to Omilia’s markets.
  
**Technical skills:** Praat, ELAN, Audacity, PLS/CMUdict/SSML lexicon formats, Phonetisaurus/Sequitur/neural G2P, basic Python or shell scripting, TTS text normalization.

Development in professional growth (courses, training, etc);
  
Being part of successful cutting\-edge technology products that are making a global impact in the service industry;
  
Proficient and fun\-to\-work\-with colleagues;
  
Apple gear.

description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

  

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

  

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**The opportunity**
-------------------


This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.


As a Manager in AI/ML Team, you will play a critical leadership role in designing, delivering and scaling AI\-driven solutions for our clients. You will lead teams, engage with senior client stakeholders, and translate complex business challenges into secure, ethical and high‑impact AI/ML solutions. This role combines hands‑on technical expertise with solution leadership, people development and client relationship management.

**Your key responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Lead and manage end‑to‑end delivery of AI/ML engagements, from use‑case identification and solution design through development, testing, deployment and optimization.
* Partner with client leadership and key stakeholders to understand strategic business objectives, operating models and technology landscapes that AI solutions will support.
* Collaborate closely with architects, data scientists, engineers and cross‑functional teams to design robust, scalable AI/ML solutions that integrate seamlessly with clients’ existing technology stacks.
* Provide technical and delivery leadership to project teams, including coaching junior team members and overseeing quality, timelines and outcomes.
* Establish and enforce AI development and testing standards, including functional, performance, security, privacy, explainability and ethical considerations.
* Stay current on emerging AI/ML tools, platforms, frameworks and regulations, and proactively assess their applicability to client engagements.
* Identify and mitigate delivery risks, including model bias, data quality issues, security concerns and regulatory implications.
* Support business development activities, including contributing to proposals, estimates, solution architectures and thought leadership.

**Skills and attributes for success**
-------------------------------------

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to translate ambiguity into structured, actionable AI solutions.
* Proven ability to lead teams and influence stakeholders across technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging at senior client and executive levels.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities, balancing delivery, people leadership and client expectations.
* A growth mindset with a passion for continuous learning and innovation in AI and data‑driven technologies.

**To qualify for the role you must have**
-----------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field.
* 6\+ years of experience delivering AI/ML solutions, including leadership of project teams; prior experience in professional services or consulting is an asset.
* Strong hands‑on experience with cloud‑based AI/ML services (AWS, Azure and/or GCP).
* Advanced proficiency in Python and experience with AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch or Scikit‑learn.
* Experience designing and executing testing strategies for AI/ML systems, including functional, performance and model‑level validation.
* Solid understanding of MLOps practices, version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines for AI systems.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**
-----------------------------

* Deep understanding of AI testing methodologies, including bias and fairness testing, robustness testing, explainability and security testing.
* Hands‑on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP) and generative AI frameworks.
* Familiarity with AI‑specific testing and monitoring tools such as DeepChecks or similar platforms.
* Experience with API design, integration and deployment of AI‑enabled services.
* Experience working with clients operating nationally and globally.

 **What we offer you**

  

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well\-being. Plus, we offer:  

  

* Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
* Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
  

EY reports salary ranges in accordance with applicable provincial pay transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary ranges noted below are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge, and applicable skill sets.
